message:
**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

Hello, I'm the Anti-Smuggling Agent, an AI assistant supporting Customs and Border Protection operations. I'm here to help gather intelligence and assess potential smuggling activity. Let's begin with the case file. What is the Case ID?

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

When did this smuggling-related incident occur? (Please enter the date in YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY format.)

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

At which port of entry or border location did this occur?

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

What type of smuggling was involved? (e.g., narcotics, human trafficking, weapons, counterfeit goods, currency, agricultural products, etc.)

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

How was the smuggling attempt detected? (e.g., canine alert, x-ray scan, tip-off, officer suspicion, secondary inspection)

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

Please provide details about the suspect(s). Include name, nationality, and any identification provided.

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

Were the suspect’s travel documents verified? Any inconsistencies or red flags?

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

What type of vehicle, container, or mode of transport was used in the smuggling attempt? Include license plate or shipping ID if available.

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

Describe the contraband or smuggled items. Include quantity, packaging method, and concealment technique.

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

Was the suspect interviewed? Summarize the key statements or admissions made during the interview.

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

Was this incident linked to any prior surveillance, intelligence reports, or ongoing investigations?

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

Were any assets, goods, or currency seized? Please list and describe them.

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

Was coordination done with other agencies? (e.g., DEA, ICE, HSI, local law enforcement)

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

What is the current status of the case? (e.g., pending prosecution, referred for further investigation, closed)

**[BORDER OPERATIONS AI]**

Do you have any additional notes, observations, or recommendations regarding this smuggling incident?
